Learn one workflow, then repeat it with a different dataset. Start with the required workspace setup and follow the synthetic practice in order. Use the same seven steps for DietSwap, Mouse59, and your own study.

## One workflow for every dataset

1. Define the question.
2. Preview the results.
3. Meet the inputs.
4. Check the inputs.
5. Run the analysis.
6. Verify and explain.
7. Write the report.

## The datasets

| Dataset | What you will learn |
|---|---|
| Synthetic practice | Read and check results from 24 samples and 15 fictional features |
| DietSwap | Describe a selected cohort comparison using 38 participant samples |
| Mouse59 | Explore 59 samples and 2,027 OTUs, including low-count samples |
| Your own study | Prepare three tidy TSV files and apply the same workflow |

::: {.callout-note}
Setup is required before running the workflow. Each dataset follows the same page structure. Its question, input/output folders, and dataset-specific details change; the analysis steps stay the same.
:::

The guide starts from prepared feature tables and produces descriptive results. Raw sequencing processing and statistical hypothesis testing require additional workflows.
